name: tiny_k_gemm
description: Thin-K GEMM for decode projections: out = cast(x.float() @ w.float().T, out_dtype), where x is [M,K], w is [N,K], and out is [M,N]. The K loop is tiled and accumulated in float32. out_dtype is a torch.dtype and may be bfloat16 or float32. Returns a newly allocated output and does not mutate x or w. Suites exercise bfloat16 x/w with bfloat16 and float32 output dtypes.
